result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority, the same order as the sales rep's list.

The change is one SQL `ORDER BY` in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart10.java` (around line 825). I also updated its Javadoc to match. The only caller is the region overview in `RegionManagerService`, so nothing else changes. Closed tickets and other regions are still filtered out as before.

`RegionManagerTest` passes offline. The existing test has only one open ticket per region, so it doesn't exercise the new order. I didn't add a test for the T-1…T-5 example, to keep the change small. I haven't committed anything.
